reactions.name: MDEA-dissociation
reactions.interpretation: K is dimensionless; correlation is natural ln K: a and c dimensionless, b in K, d in 1/K, reference_temperature and temperature limits in K; reference_pressure_pa in Pa. Negative stoichiometric coefficients are reactants; positive coefficients are products. Extent unit: mol of reaction as written. Enthalpy follows the declared K(T) law and its source_basis/standard_state_id, with Engine reference conversion; it is not an independently fitted heat.
